items.difficulty_reason: The proof runs the framework lemma with the cube diagram: quasi-compactness is reduced to fibres over affine test schemes, the base change along $Y \times_Z Z' \to Y$ (affine, flat, surjective) shows the test fibre is quasi-compact over the chart, and a surjection from a quasi-compact space concludes.
